item.tib: kun tu bzang po 'khor ba stong par 'dren pa'i rgyud las gzhung gi mtha' bsgyur skal ldan gson byang yan lag bag chags sgrib sbyong thabs
item.coloph: skal ldan bag sgrib sbyang thabs 'di/ ye shes lha yis lung bstan bzhin/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin gyis/ yi ge ris su bkod pa'o/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
